components.css: .ds-qa{color:var(--color-fg,#f3f4f6);font:11px 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;border-block:1px solid var(--color-line,rgb(255 255 255 / .08))}.ds-qa summary{padding:12px 2px;cursor:pointer}.ds-qa summary:hover{background:#ffffff03}.ds-qa summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-indigo,#818cf8);outline-offset:4px}.ds-qa pre{background:#040509;color:#bdc5d4;padding:11px;border-radius:4px;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10px;line-height:1.7}

narrative.overview: A chronological room trace, inspectable verification evidence, and a prominent current verdict. Evidence determines every status.

rules.name: Tonal depth
rules.body: Use surface tone, hairlines, and restrained state tint; no drop-shadow vocabulary.

rules.name: Evidence typography
rules.body: Use JetBrains Mono and tabular figures for commands, IDs, SHAs, durations, and output.

dos: Show text and icons alongside status color.
Keep historical check inspection separate from current verdict state.
Preserve keyboard focus, disclosures, and reduced-motion behavior.
Label scripted and test-verifier recordings accurately.
donts: Invent verification data or approval evidence.
